summary: Frontend-only testing of the new 'Our Impact Across India' interactive map feature on Home (/) and dedicated /impact page. All acceptance criteria pass: impact-map-section renders after ImpactMetrics, india-map-svg present, all 6 pins (delhi, rewari, dehradun, bengaluru, bhubaneswar, pune) rendered with 5 connector lines radiating from Pune hub. City selector buttons update the detail card with distinct correct content (verified 3 cities: Dehradun/Uttarakhand, Bengaluru/Karnataka, Bhubaneswar/Odisha with unique context text). Desktop tooltip 'City · State' appears near active pin (verified 'Bengaluru · Karnataka'). Bilingual toggle works — Bengaluru button switches to 'बेंगलुरु' / 'कर्नाटक' on HI and back on EN. 'Explore our impact' CTA navigates to /impact. /impact page renders PageHeader, same map (6 pins), stats strip with 20+ Sessions Held, 700+ People Reached, 6 States & UTs (count-ups fire on scroll), and CTAs impact-cta-workshop -> /request-workshop and impact-cta-donate -> /donate work. Zero console errors observed on either page.
critical_code_review_comments: ImpactMap.jsx: onHoverEnd on marker sets active to null which conflicts with left-list button hover having just set it — minor UX churn on desktop hover between list and pin, but functionally acceptable.
impactMap.js path is a very large single string (~50KB); consider moving to a separate JSON/module to keep the data file cache-friendly and reduce JS parse time.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified end-to-end on desktop 1920x1080. Pin drop-in animation ~0.8s + 0.15s stagger — wait ~3s after scrolling section into view. Tooltip is hidden on <640px by design; detail card is mobile fallback (not retested on mobile viewport).
